name: Del Mar Golf Center
address: 15555 Jimmy Durante Blvd, Del Mar, CA 92014-1901, US

booking.howItWorks: Parties and group events are booked by sending a reservation request form; staff confirm, then a $50 deposit secures a birthday party. Group event requests get a reply within 72 hours. Bays are booked online.

serviceCharge.note: 18% gratuity added for birthday parties of 8 or more and for all group events.

packages.name: Toptracer Bay
packages.description: Hourly Toptracer bay rental. Up to 5 players per bay with seating for 4, unlimited golf balls for your time. Book more hours if you like. Contact us to reserve 3 or more bays.

packages.name: Toptracer Suite
packages.description: Hourly suite rental with more space for groups of up to 9 people. Unlimited golf balls for your reserved time.

faq.q: Is there a minimum or maximum for birthday parties?
faq.a: There is a minimum of 8. Our largest patio can hold up to 40.
Group events require a minimum of 15 people and can accommodate up to 75 guests. Larger groups may also be possible depending on the package and event requirements.

faq.q: Do I have to bring paper goods?
faq.a: We will provide generic paper goods (plates, cups, utensils). If you are having a themed party, you may bring themed plates, etc.
No, you must provide your own cake or cupcakes.

faq.q: Can I bring my own food?
faq.a: For birthday parties, the only outside food we allow is your cake or cupcakes. For group events outside food is not permitted; our on-site café can prepare food and refreshments.
Outside alcohol is not allowed. We offer beer, hard seltzers, hard ciders, and white and red wine.
Birthday groups of 8 or more will have an 18% gratuity added to the final bill. An 18% gratuity is added to all group events.

faq.q: Will staff stay with us for the entire party?
faq.a: Your party host will take your food order, serve your lunch, and make sure you have everything you need. They do not accompany you on the course.

faq.q: Can the children play by themselves?
faq.a: Groups are 4 or 5 children, no more than 5. There must be at least 1 adult to accompany each group of children.

faq.q: Do adults and siblings play for free?
faq.a: There will be an additional charge for the adults and non-party children.

faq.q: What about food for the adults?
faq.a: You may order additional pizza, veggie trays, fruit trays, or chips and salsa; these must be ordered 24 hours in advance. Party children are always fed first.

faq.q: What is the birthday party deposit?
faq.a: Once we confirm your reservation, a $50 deposit is required. The deposit is non-refundable within 48 hours of the party.

faq.q: What if the weather is bad?
faq.a: Pelly's Mini Golf will reschedule the party at the earliest mutually agreed-upon time. If that time is not acceptable, the $50 deposit will be refunded.

faq.q: What is the bay cancellation policy?
faq.a: Bay reservations are treated like tee times and are non-refundable within 24 hours. Bay reservations can be made up to 7 days in advance.

faq.q: Is there a deposit for large bay groups?
faq.a: $50 deposit is required for groups of 15 or more. The deposit is non-refundable within 48 hours. Contact us to reserve 3 or more bays for your group.

faq.q: Do you have dietary options and golf equipment?
faq.a: Yes. Vegetarian and gluten-free food options are available. We provide putters, golf balls, scorecards, and pencils.
